title: Sunny D – Fruit Juice Drink with Added Calcium

content.title: About
content.content: Sunny D is a non‑alcoholic fruit juice drink fortified with calcium. It is made from orange juice, water, sugar, natural flavorings, and calcium added as an easily absorbable salt. The beverage is marketed as a source of B‑vitamins and bone‑supporting nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The Sunny D brand was launched in the United States in the 1970s and quickly became popular with children.
Calcium is added as calcium phosphate, which does not alter the taste.
One serving provides more than the daily recommended amount of vitamin C for adults.
The drink is often used in school cafeterias as an alternative to regular juices.
Sunny D’s bright orange color comes from natural carotenoids.

items.title: Bone support
items.content: Added calcium helps maintain bone density, especially important for growing children and teenagers.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immunity and participates in collagen synthesis.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Simple sugars quickly replenish energy stores after physical activity.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The high water content aids in maintaining proper fluid balance.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B2 and B6 support carbohydrate and protein metabolism.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Regular consumption may contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of dental caries.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: People allergic to oranges or other citrus fruits may experience reactions.

items.title: Excess calcium
items.content: Overconsumption can put strain on the kidneys, especially in individuals prone to kidney stones.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The drink’s acidic pH may irritate a sensitive stomach.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Sunny D is typically served chilled. It can be enjoyed on its own, used in cocktails, smoothies, or diluted with water to reduce sweetness.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
